text:
Ellen Park: Quick internal GA note 1: Hosted "Nimbus" family is going GA on hosted API today. Nimbus is a set of ultra-low-memory quantized models optimized for edge-like latency and integrates natively with tool-calling & streaming. Rolling out region-by-region over ~2 hours. :rocket:
Rohit Desai: awesome. any breaking changes or new endpoints?
Ellen Park: new unified endpoint: POST /v1/nimbus. Existing model endpoints remain available during rollout. Nimbus supports streaming partials + toolcall multiplexing out of the box. Optional headers: `X-Redwood-Nimbus-Trace: 1` for sampled traces and `X-Redwood-Nimbus-Mode: prefetch|conservative` to bias prefetch behavior.
Maya Gupta: runtime and ops notes?
eng-sre-bot: runbook posted: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/nimbus-ga. Key alerts: p95 token-latency +25% or tool-prefetch-error >1% sustained 5m -> escalate. Canary keys: nimbus-canary-01..07. Auto-rollback policy present.
Ellen Park: billing: Nimbus uses the same per-token billing but may route to quantized variants which reduce unit cost; prefetch bundles (optional) incur a small per-bundle fee labeled `nimbus-prefetch`. Trace exports are opt-in and billed under debug-exports.
docs-bot: docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/nimbus (migration guide, API schema, js/python/curl examples, and cost examples)
Rohit Desai: Dedicated / Private customers?
Ellen Park: Dedicated: Admin -> Feature Flags -> EnableNimbus. Private/on-prem: Nimbus included in the 2.4.0 bundle; operators must apply the nimbus-agent patch and run the compatibility script (link in docs).
Maya Gupta: deprecation or compatibility notes?
Ellen Park: Deprecation: legacy `lite-gen` endpoint will be deprecated 2027-01-15; we'll provide an automatic compatibility proxy for 6 months. Migration guide and opt-in timeline in docs.
Rohit Desai: pasteable curl for eng channel?
Ellen Park: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/nimbus \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Nimbus-Trace: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"nimbus-mini","input":"Summarize today\u2019s release notes","mode":"prefetch"}'
```
Maya Gupta: marketing/customer comms?
product-bot: Product will send staged emails to accounts using legacy-lite endpoints and publish a changelog + short demo video. CS will get an export of affected accounts for outreach.
Ellen Park: final: internal AMA at 16:30 PT in #product. If you see regressions during rollout, tag @eng-sre and include the canary key. Please don't flip the global toggle unless you're on the rollout team. :white_check_mark:
